key_geographic_observations: Real map shows a dense suburban street grid throughout the USID_00 coverage area (~33.023N, -96.703W), consistent with the Garland/Richardson suburban corridor of Dallas Metro.
Major N-S arterial road (thick gray line) visible on the western side of the map (~lon -96.717) — outside USID_00's dominance boundary and not intersecting the target footprint.
No hospital symbols, large commercial footprints, or expressway infrastructure identifiable within or immediately adjacent to USID_00's 26-pixel boundary.

Green area visible in the upper-right of the real map (east of ~-96.695) consistent with a park or open space — outside USID_00's footprint but explains lower density in the eastern backup zone served by USID_29/37.

impact_zones.location: NW/center quadrant, inner portion of USID_00 dominance boundary

evidence.signal_evidence: USID_27 rsrp_in_zone_p50 = -57.6 dBm (preprocessing per_backup) — well above -80 dBm strong threshold; 100% of absorbed pixels above good. RSRP_USID_27 image confirms deep blue throughout the W/center overlap with USID_00's red-dashed boundary.
evidence.sinr_evidence: Three-signal classification — Signal 1 (replaceability): USID_27 easy_gap_fraction = 0.5625 vs hard_gap_fraction = 0.0625; easy_gap dominates (ratio 9:1) → replaceability = easy. Signal 2 (environment): USID_00 rsrp_p50 = -57.0 dBm > -90 dBm → environment = good. Signal 3 (SINR): target_dom_low_sinr_fraction = 0.6923 > 0.30 → sinr = low. RULE 2 applies (easy + good + low) → interference_limited. Visual confirmation: SINR map shows predominantly cyan-blue tones inside the red contour in the NW sub-zone, consistent with 69.2% low-SINR fraction. Preprocessing regime_interference_limited_fraction for USID_27 = 0.5625.
evidence.geographic_evidence: Regular residential street grid visible in the NW sector of the real map — uniform block pattern with no hospital, commercial, or highway features identifiable.

impact_zones.location: E/SE quadrant, inner-to-outer USID_00 dominance boundary

evidence.signal_evidence: USID_29 rsrp_in_zone_p50 = -58.83 dBm (preprocessing per_backup) — well above -80 dBm strong threshold; 100% above good. RSRP_USID_29 image confirms deep blue across the E/center of USID_00's red-dashed boundary.
evidence.sinr_evidence: Three-signal classification — Signal 1 (replaceability): USID_29 easy_gap_fraction = 0.6364 vs hard_gap_fraction = 0.0909; easy_gap dominates (ratio 7:1) → replaceability = easy. Signal 2 (environment): USID_00 rsrp_p50 = -57.0 dBm → good. Signal 3 (SINR): dom_low_sinr_fraction = 0.6923 > 0.30 → low. RULE 2 applies → interference_limited. SINR map shows cyan-blue tones in the SE sub-zone inside the red contour. Preprocessing regime_interference_limited_fraction for USID_29 = 0.6364.
evidence.geographic_evidence: Continuous residential suburban grid visible in the center and SE sector of the real map under USID_00's boundary — same block pattern as the NW zone; no commercial or critical infrastructure visible.
evidence.load_evidence: USID_29 overload_risk = low (0.011); USID_37 overload_risk = low (0.005) — Stage 1.

impact_zones.location: S/SW edge, outer boundary of USID_00 dominance area — coverage hole

evidence.signal_evidence: No backup signal reaches this zone — grey pixels visible at the S/SW edge of the RSRP_USID_00 image below the flat southern portion of the yellow boundary. coverage_hole_fraction = 0.1154 (3 of 26 pixels, from preprocessing). Classified very_weak per coverage hole rule (no backup at all).
evidence.sinr_evidence: Three-signal classification cannot be applied — no backup exists for this zone. sinr_regime defaults to mixed. For reference: SINR map shows cyan-blue tones at the S edge of the red contour; target_dom_low_sinr_fraction = 0.6923 and target_dom_high_sinr_fraction = 0.1538.
evidence.geographic_evidence: Residential street grid continues uninterrupted into the S/SW sector of the real map with no change in land character — same block pattern south of USID_00's tower position confirms residential classification.
evidence.load_evidence: No backup available — no handover target; coverage hole confirmed by preprocessing coverage_hole_fraction = 0.1154.

coverage_hole_geographic_assessment.hole_location_description: Grey pixels at the S/SW fringe of USID_00's yellow dominance boundary in the RSRP_USID_00 image. The flat southern edge of the yellow boundary at ~lat 33.022 marks the handover boundary below which no neighbor's signal reaches.

load_geographic_context.primary_backup_area_character: USID_27 is a micro tower (~33.027, -96.707) NW of USID_00 serving the same dense suburban residential fabric. High-band-only (2600/3500 MHz), 5G-capacity-fill profile; compact own dominance zone collocated with the same residential land use as USID_00.
load_geographic_context.notes: No critical infrastructure identified in USID_00's dominance area or primary backup area. All three zones share the same residential suburban character. USID_29 and USID_37 (both 40m macro, 4-band) serve the E residential area with equivalent quality.

key_findings_for_stage4: Both covered zones (NW and SE) classify as interference_limited via RULE 2 of the three-signal method — USID_27 easy_gap=0.5625 and USID_29 easy_gap=0.6364 confirm backups were already competitive pre-outage; practical service quality drop is low despite high user relevance.
11.54% coverage hole at the S/SW residential edge is the sole HIGH-severity zone — complete signal loss for 3 pixels of residential area with no handover target for the full 4-hour window.
No critical infrastructure identified in any zone — C2 escalation is not triggered.
USID_41 covers the N/NW arc (34.6%) with a 4G-dominant profile — users in this sub-zone may experience 5G-to-4G downgrade, but in-zone RSRP is strong (-58.5 dBm) and overload risk is low.
Interference_limited classification across 88.46% of the target area is directly consistent with preprocessing dominant_area_mild_fraction = 1.0 — confirming C3 applies in Stage 4.

reasons: Real map available — land use from visible street grid patterns, not inferred from signal.
Three-signal sinr_regime fully grounded in preprocessing fractions (easy_gap, hard_gap, rsrp_p50, dom_low_sinr_fraction) with SINR map visual confirmation.
Signal condition thresholds applied mechanically from per_backup rsrp_in_zone_p50_dbm values.
Residual uncertainty: exact sub-pixel land use within the 3-pixel hole — classified residential from continuous grid pattern with no conflicting map evidence.
